Voxel Game Engine
Learn about the features, specifications and platforms of the Voxel Game Engine, a software voxel renderer and game engine that uses volume raycasting and iso surface/volume rendering. The engine supports voxel graphics authoring tools, polygon model to voxel conversion, 3D scanning, stereoscopic 3D, augmented reality and virtual reality.
